notes.title: Update to One by one: current word list
notes.content:
New Feature: +1 View full list and current line
The "don't randomize but go one by one" button got a right click menu to show all the filtered words, have the current marked and click to jump to specific word. 

Quality of life improvements:
Paste a word list, seperated by new line into the first column. (useful when pasting from ChatGPT)

Some fixes
Download folders vere partially hidden sometimes
Couldn't delete folders
Some adding new folder crash

notes.title: Update Notes Juli
notes.content:
Improvements: 
When moving a word comma gets also moved now
When splitting a text prompt, parameters now are added without commas inbetween
Adding words by typing or pasting are now added after the last word under cursor

Fixes:
Fixed clicking a folder opening last used folder
Fixed changing from filtered to plain word
Fixed parameter decimal values
Fixed couldn’t set clipboard error messages

notes.title: Hotkeys & download folders update
notes.content:
Following updates available in beta: 
.Hotkeys added to settings (three for now)
.Download folders are now themable (in settings) and functionality has been improved
.Minimode now expands on dragging in images to display the download folders 
.Ctrl+V now pastes words right away into the prompt box

tags.feature: .Hotkeys added to settings (three for now)
.Download folders are now themable (in settings) and functionality has been improved
.Minimode now expands on dragging in images to display the download folders
.Ctrl+V now pastes words right away into the prompt box

notes.title: Previous functionality ++
notes.content:
Couple of functions have been added. They are functional but not completely finished yet: 
1. Dropzones in full window now, for images you can drop into one of the added folders
2. Selected Wordtypes can now be pulled in from all the themes
3. Hiding section buttons have been updated
4. Prompt layouts have been added above the prompt box. 

I think the default functionality should be restored for now, 
further fixes will follow soon!

tags.feature: 1. Dropzones in full window now, for images you can drop into one of the added folders
2. Selected Wordtypes can now be pulled in from all the themes
3. Hiding section buttons have been updated
4. Prompt layouts have been added above the prompt box.

notes.title: Patch with couple of features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added some functions to the top bar: Open Download folder, Switch to AI and Toggle Window MiniMode
[*] Middle click on wordtype checkboxes to randomize that wordtype
[*] Press F1 while hovering over a word to look it up (searchengine = currently ecosia, will make it adjustable)
[*] Fixed, changed, upgraded prompt adapter workflow
[*] Cleanup at saving word themes (removes duplicate words)
[*] Select/unselect All checkboxes
[/list]

Upcomming features (this week):
[list]
[*] Taking in prompts from text will automatically find and connect to existing words in libraries
[*] New wordtypes: those will probably be Emotions, Abstract, Shapes & Texture
[*] Wordthemes (probably Scifi, Nice things, Photogrophy, Nature)
[/list]
